loginsHelp: Set up each web server once. Every website of this workspace can publish to it, each into its own folder or subdomain.
loginRemoveHelp: Websites that use this login will ask for another one before they publish again.
loginChecked: Signed in successfully. Nothing was changed on the server.
loginKeyHelp: Signs in with your SSH key or agent. The server's host key must already be known to your SSH client.
loginFtpImplicit: FTPS on its own port (usually 990), encrypted
loginFtpPlainWarning: Without encryption, your password and every file travel readable over the network. Use it only when the host offers nothing else.
loginPasswordRemember: Keep the password on this computer
loginPasswordSaved: A password is kept on this computer, encrypted. It never leaves this computer and is not part of the workspace.
loginPasswordSession: The password is held until Observanda closes; this computer cannot keep it encrypted.
loginPasswordMissing: No password on this computer yet.
pubRepositoryUploaded: Repository files uploaded and verified. Pages settings were left unchanged.
pubSshUploaded: Uploaded and verified on the SSH server. Check the live manifest to verify the web server.
pubPagesFailed: Files uploaded and verified. GitHub Pages setup failed; check Pages permissions/settings before retrying.
pubPagesPending: Files uploaded and verified. GitHub Pages deployment is pending; check the live manifest after deployment.
